data.description: The Mini Fridge is for preserving food and keeping items cool, with 18 slots of storage. For power, it draws 2 rW through a single Power In input. Craft it at a tier 1 workbench for 50 frags, and research it for 20 [scrap](/items/scrap) or unlock it for 5 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total on the tech tree. Skins are available for it, and a Green Recycler gives back 25 frags.
data.name: Mini Fridge
data.seoDescription: Mini Fridge in Rust: uses 2 rW, 18 slots, craft with 50 Metal Fragments.
